dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Department of Veterans Affairs and health care entities or providers submitting claims under the Veterans Community Care Program.
dimensions.evidence: a claim submitted to the Secretary by a health care entity or provider that furnishes hospital care, medical services, or extended care services under this chapter

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory IT system functions for continuous claims monitoring and post-payment analysis, and extends a pension payment limitation limit.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to use an information technology system to detect fraud, waste, and abuse regarding claims for payment

dimensions.assessment: Requires the VA to use its franchise fund to implement the IT system and aims to generate estimated savings through fraud detection, while also extending a pension payment limit to January 30, 2034.
dimensions.evidence: To carry out this section, the Secretary shall use funds from the Department of Veterans Affairs franchise fund

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code to mandate specific technological capabilities and reporting requirements for VA health care claims management.
dimensions.evidence: The information technology system described in this subsection shall include the following functions: Continuous monitoring of claims

dimensions.assessment: Imposes ongoing requirements with multi-year reporting mandates (annually for five years following implementation) and extends an existing statutory pension limit through 2034.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter for five additional years

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts stored in or allocated from the VA franchise fund for this IT implementation.
importance_detail.rationale: The FRAUD Act of 2025 requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to deploy a specific information technology system to detect, analyze, and prevent fraud, waste, and abuse in the Veterans Community Care Program, using funds from the VA franchise fund and submitting annual reports.
